column1: # PARTITION.tsv - what may be published and what is held.
# Douglas set the rule on 2026-09-11: "all of our continuing crypto work is not for the general
# public it wouldnt do anyone any good." The default is therefore HELD, and PUBLIC is the exception
# that has to be argued for. An artifact absent from this file is HELD, because a manifest that
# treats an unlisted file as publishable turns every new document into a leak by default.
# HE NARROWED IT THE SAME DAY: "dont include any advantage research, that gives away our advantage.
# precision fair." That draws the line somewhere other than crypto-versus-not. Held is whatever IS
# the advantage, meaning what the engine is pointed at and what was found by pointing it. Fair is the
# precision work itself, because general-purpose arithmetic does not reveal what it is aimed at.
# CLASSES
#   PUBLIC    Already published in anchor_sift/theory. Leave where it is.
#   EXTERNAL  Cleared for publication under "precision fair" and not yet out. Ranks with PUBLIC in
#             check_partition.py, since neither constrains a book. Kept distinct from PUBLIC so that
#             "cleared but unpublished" is counted instead of assumed.
#   HELD      Not for the general public. Builds into a held book only.
# PENDING IS GONE, AND ITS ROWS ARE NOW HELD. It existed for nine documents whose method is generic
# while every worked example is SHA-256. Under the narrowed rule the examples decide it: a document
# teaching a method through the advantage work carries the advantage. Extracting the generic method
# into something publishable is a new document somebody writes deliberately, and never a
# reclassification of these.
# The reclassification moved every undecided row in the fail-closed direction, which needed no
# ruling. The precision work is fair under the narrowed rule and is classified EXTERNAL, which
# Douglas confirmed directly rather than this session inferring it.
# TWO GATES, BOTH OF WHICH MUST PASS BEFORE ANYTHING IS EXTERNAL
# Douglas set the second one on 2026-09-11, and it is not a restatement of the first:
#   "anything that wont give away advantages that we are keeping internal I will share this with
#    other scientists but it would fuck the btc ecosystem up and even though I dont like or approve
#    of it I think thats wrong because people I dont know depend on it"
#   GATE 1, ADVANTAGE. Does releasing it give away what the engine is pointed at, or what was found
#                      by pointing it? If yes, HELD. Subject column reads "advantage" or the domain.
#   GATE 2, HARM.      Would releasing it damage the people who depend on the network? If yes, HELD,
#                      EVEN WHERE GATE 1 CLEARS IT. Subject column reads "ecosystem".
# GATE 2 CAN HOLD SOMETHING GATE 1 RELEASES, and that is the entire reason it is written separately.
# A result can be no advantage to us at all - a structural weakness anybody could rediscover, a
# finding we have no way to use - and still be the wrong thing to hand out, because the cost falls
# on people who never chose to take the risk and are not party to any of this.
# The reverse does not hold. Gate 2 never releases anything gate 1 holds. An advantage stays held
# whether or not publishing it would harm anyone.
# HOW TO APPLY GATE 2 WITHOUT IT SWALLOWING THE TREE. It asks about the standard and the network,
# never about this repository's fortunes. Publishing the FIPS 180-4 compression function harms
# nobody: it is the specification, implemented correctly, and a tool that regrades every copy of its
# constant table against the primes makes a corrupted table easier to catch rather than harder.
# Publishing interior structure that narrows the search is the case gate 2 exists for.
# A NOTE ON WHAT THE SHA-256 RESEARCH ACTUALLY FOUND, since it bears on gate 2 and reads backwards
# otherwise. The transform workbook's hypotheses came back null: survivor counts track the cost
# model exactly, no bit or byte position departs from flat, and the standing constraint is that no
# projection over the digest can reduce the number of evaluations at all. Those results are held
# under gate 1, as method and instruments, and not because they weaken anything.
# COLUMNS   path  class  subject  reason
# Owner: dstroy0 (Douglas Quigg) <dquigg123@gmail.com>
# Written by the research assistant session, 2026-09-11. Every class below is either quoted from
# Douglas's rule or defaulted to HELD. Nothing was promoted on this session's own judgment.

column4: reason

column1: # THE PRECISION FILES THAT ARE NOT EXTERNAL. Listed so every exclusion is deliberate and visible,
# because an omission nobody can see is the thing that reads as concealment.
# ANISOTROPY IS INTERNAL. Douglas, same evening: "Anything we are using to derive anisotropic

# same footing as what it derives.
# AND THE EXTERNAL BUCKET MUST NOT BE A REDACTED VERSION OF A BIGGER ONE. Douglas: "The people
# working the field will know instantly this is gatekeeping laypeople for malfeasance." He is right,
# and it decides the shape rather than the contents. Cutting the obvious steps out of a paper fools
# nobody who works in the field and insults everyone who does not, so the test is not "what can be
# removed" but "is what remains a whole subject".
# What remains is: arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic, an NTT multiply with certified moduli, and
# integer relation detection. That is a complete subject with its own results, its own gates and no
# holes in it. It is not the anisotropy work with the anisotropy taken out.
# Spherical harmonics are left out for the opposite reason to secrecy. Douglas: "Anyone not a
# dumbass will know on their own to use spherical harmonics, leave that out." Including an obvious
# choice of basis as though it were a contribution is padding, not disclosure.
